debate: Hayley

Fellow villagers, I’m Hayley and I’m the Seer. In Round 0 I checked Jacob—he is a Werewolf. In Round 1 I checked Derek—he was our Doctor, which explains why the wolves killed him last night. We cannot afford mistakes; Jacob must be lynched today. Please join me in voting Jacob.
Sam

Hayley, thanks for stepping up as Seer and sharing those results. Before we lock in on Jacob, I’m puzzled: you say you checked Derek and found he was Doctor—yet he was killed last night. Could you clarify exactly when (which night) you checked him? I want to make sure we’re not acting on a misread. Scott, David, Jackson, Leah—what do you make of this timeline?
Scott

Sam’s spot-on: Hayley, your timeline needs clarity. Did you check Jacob on Night 0 and Derek on Night 1? If your Night 1 check showed the Doctor, why reveal it only after Derek died? I’m not comfortable lynching Jacob until we have exact nights confirmed. Jackson, Leah, David—what do you make of this sequence? Let’s settle the timing before voting.
David

Sam and Scott raise the exact issue I was seeing—Hayley, your Seer timeline doesn’t add up. You claim Jacob was checked on Night 0 and Derek on Night 1, yet Derek died that same night despite being Doctor. Which night did you actually check Derek? If it was Night 1, why didn’t your check stop the kill? If it was Night 0, are your Jacob/Werewolf results swapped? We need those exact nights before we vote Jacob.
Jacob

I’m with Sam, Scott, and David—Hayley’s Seer story doesn’t make sense. If she checked Derek last night as Doctor, why didn’t that save him? And if that check was Night 0, did she mix up Jacob and Derek? It feels like classic misdirection. Before we turn on anyone else, why not put Hayley on trial? Let’s vote her up for clarification rather than risking another innocent.
Jackson

Hayley, your Seer claim just doesn’t stand up. You say you checked Derek on Night 1 and found the Doctor, yet he was killed that same night—impossible if you’d actually saved him. And if that check was Night 0, your Jacob result must be swapped. Sam and David have already pointed out this timeline disaster, so let’s not risk another innocent today. I’m voting to put Hayley up for clarification immediately. If she’s truly our Seer, nothing’s lost; if she’s lying, we’ll catch her now.
Leah

Everyone’s pointed out that Hayley’s Seer timeline simply doesn’t work—if she truly checked Derek last night, he’d have been saved, and if she checked him on Night 0 her Jacob read could be swapped. We can’t afford to waste another day on confusion. I propose we put Hayley on trial now. If she’s the real Seer, she’ll clear things up. If not, we root out a liar and then look for the real information behind Sam’s cautious questions.
